propositions: Markdown-aware encode functions must emit structured ADF nodes (heading, list, codeBlock) rather than literal characters in paragraph text
HTML comments present in source markdown must survive the round-trip markdown→ADF→markdown without loss
Combined strong+strikethrough marks must converge to a deterministic order to prevent infinite 2-cycle oscillation during repeated round-trips
Markdown-to-ADF conversion must degrade gracefully to plain-text fallback when marklas is unavailable, preserving the stdlib-only engine contract
Corpus round-trip idempotence must reach fixed point after one pass for ≥99.6% of bodies with zero conversion errors
The lazy-import design must be applied inside function bodies with ImportError routing to existing plain adf.py fallback, not via vendored source
